title: Build a water filter
subject: Science
summary: Learners build a layered filter and compare water clarity before and after.
safety: Do not drink the filtered water — it is a demonstration only. Supervise scissor use.
inclusion: Pairs work well. Provide visual instruction cards for mixed reading levels.

title: Paper bridge challenge
subject: Engineering
summary: Teams design a bridge from a single sheet of paper that holds as much weight as possible.
safety: No sharp tools. Keep the floor clear of trip hazards.
inclusion: Teams of 3-4 with mixed abilities. Rotate the designer role each round.

title: Mini solar oven
subject: Science
summary: Build a box oven that uses the sun to melt chocolate or warm a small snack.
safety: Adult supervision required. Surfaces get hot — use tongs. Work outdoors or near a window.
inclusion: Outdoor activity — ensure shade breaks and water are available.

title: Binary name bracelet
subject: Maths
summary: Learners encode their initials in binary using two bead colours.
safety: Choking hazard — not suitable for children under 5.
inclusion: Works well with mixed reading levels; purely visual.

title: Tabletop wind turbine
subject: Engineering
summary: Learners build a turbine and test how blade shape affects the load it can lift.
safety: Keep fingers clear of the fan. Do not use a high-speed fan.
inclusion: Rotate roles so every learner builds a blade.

title: Red cabbage pH test
subject: Science
summary: Use red cabbage water as a natural pH indicator to test household liquids.
safety: Not for tasting. Wash hands after the activity.
inclusion: Uses low-cost, home-available materials — good for no-budget contexts.

title: Egg-drop parachute
subject: Engineering
summary: Design a parachute that slows a falling weight as much as possible.
safety: If using real eggs, work outside or over a tray. Do not drop from a height above 2 m.
inclusion: Encourage sketches before building for learners who prefer planning.

title: Balloon rocket
subject: Science
summary: Thread a straw on a string and propel a balloon along it to show thrust.
safety: Balloon pieces are a choking hazard — supervise closely.
inclusion: Simple, high-energy activity that works for large groups.

title: Edible DNA model
subject: Biology
summary: Build a double-helix model from sweets to represent base pairing.
safety: Check for food allergies before starting. Wash hands.
inclusion: Offer a non-edible alternative (beads + wire) for dietary or allergy needs.

title: Suspension bridge
subject: Engineering
summary: Build a suspension bridge and test how much weight it can carry.
safety: Tape down sharp edges. Keep the testing area clear.
inclusion: Split into specialised roles: designer, builder, tester, recorder.

title: Caesar cipher wheel
subject: Maths
summary: Make a rotating cipher wheel and exchange secret messages.
inclusion: Non-verbal learners can participate fully by decoding.

title: Keep it cool — insulation test
subject: Science
summary: Wrap bottles in different materials and measure which keeps water coldest.
safety: Wipe up spills. Glass bottles should be handled by an adult.
inclusion: Compare results on a shared class chart so non-writers can contribute.
